name: get_customer
description: Look up a customer by customer ID. Returns the customer's name, email, loyalty tier, member-since date and order IDs. Customer IDs look like "C-1001". To find out who placed an order, call get_order_status first and use the customer_id it returns.

customer_id.description: Customer ID in the form C-NNNN, for example "C-1001".
